    Minimal morphisms #

    The standard right- and left-minimal predicates are useful both for almost-split morphisms and for minimal weak kernels and cokernels.

    source
    def MBDVendor.QSE.IsRightMinimal {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    Prop

    A morphism is right minimal when every endomorphism of its source which fixes it is invertible.
